verdict.rationale: Letta Code and CLI are extensively controlled via natural-language chat plus slash commands (/remember, /init, /fork, /btw, /doctor, /agents) that wrap agent behavior in conversational form, and agents themselves interpret natural-language instructions to manage memory, tools, and subagents. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence (beyond vendor docs/HN Q&A) confirming reliability of natural-language command interpretation across complex workflows.
